Source check: UCLA describes an ongoing pilot tested since April2026, scheduled through September2027. The campus estimate is seven tons/day; the source leaves the precise ton convention open. About2%electricity, peak support and roughly100vehicles are alternative projections. Full campus output, independently audited net climate benefit, prices and the complete storage chain remain questions for measurement. The$100,000 supports two graduate students. Analogies are explanation. Corrections: “pure black charcoal” and a sealed tin depict a different simplified mechanism and establish neither this process nor carbon storage. The sources leave actual complete campus-waste throughput open. “Future independent audits” implies a promised audit absent from the brief. Headline feeding scraps and final global-scale promise overstate the verified pilot.
